background.value: Depends on document type: White (白色) for ID card, passport, driver's license, social security card; Blue (蓝色, RGB 67,142,219) for resume, diploma, work permit, exam registration; Red (红色) for marriage certificate, party credentials

head_height.value: For passport (33x48mm): head width 15-22mm, head height (chin to crown) 28-33mm, crown to top edge 3-5mm, chin to bottom edge minimum 7mm

file_spec.value: JPEG format, 300dpi. 1寸: 295x413px; 2寸: 413x579px. File size 5KB-999KB for digital submissions. Professional photo paper printing required for physical copies

clothing_restriction.value: Dark clothing (偏深色衣服) for contrast with white background. No uniforms for government officials. For resume: formal business attire recommended

expression_restriction.value: Natural expression, eyes open, lips closed (双唇闭合). Slight smile acceptable for resume photos

glasses_policy.value: Clear/non-colored lens glasses allowed but frames cannot obscure eyes and no flash reflections. No colored lenses. For resume photos: no glasses recommended

ears_visibility.value: Both ears visible; no hair covering ears or eyebrows (for passport/ID); no ear accessories

face_visibility.value: Full face and head visible, clear facial features (五官清晰), frontal view, no shadows on face or background

headwear_policy.value: No hat or head coverings (无帽). Religious headwear permitted only if face is not obscured

accessories.value: No ear jewelry or accessories. Hearing aids acceptable. No modifications or composites

is_white_background_allowed.value: Yes - white is the standard for official ID documents (身份证, passport, driver's license). For resume specifically, blue is conventional but white is also accepted
